caption: The video captures a view from inside a moving vehicle, framed on the interior rearview mirror. The mirror reflects the street behind, where a dark hatchback with red tail lights appears alongside other cars, road markings, a lamppost, and buildings, while pedestrians appear on the reflected sidewalk. Outside the mirror, foreground scenery slides across the lower frame, passing a white building with a faded sign, shopfronts, and a long brick wall that grows into view. The mirror housing and the silhouettes of seat headrests shift and tilt within the frame, with several motion-blurred moments indicating ongoing camera shake. Within the reflection the dark car drifts toward the left edge and shrinks, and two standing pedestrians become visible on the right side of the reflected street. A pedestrian in dark clothing is briefly seen on the near sidewalk as the vehicle moves.
relations: The vehicle's movement causes the foreground scenery to slide across the lower frame.
Camera shake makes the mirror housing and headrests shift and tilt with motion blur.
Forward motion drives the reflected dark hatchback to drift left and shrink.
Vehicle movement reveals pedestrians on the right side of the reflected street.
